_metadata.description: Requirements derived from the P1 operational targets: the provenance rendering contract, the composed rooms, the ambient shell, one intent vocabulary, audience modes, and the capability ladder.

requirements.title: Provenance is rendered in material, not colour
requirements.description: Each reading renders in a material determined by its coverage and trust pair: solid for NOW+VALID, dimmed with an age for NOW+CACHED, hollow outline for IN-REACH, dotted outline for MISSING. The material carries the state on its own; colour reinforces but is never the only signal, and a greyscale render remains unambiguous.

validation.notes: Each coverage/trust pair maps to its material and survives a colour-stripped render [REQ:CC-P1-001].

requirements.title: No figure renders without its qualifier
requirements.description: A value never appears alone. A live reading shows its source and freshness, a cached reading its age, an in-reach reading what is needed to make it real, a missing reading its owner and the days it has stood. Composition does not change between states, so a metric going live is a change of weight and never a change of layout.

validation.notes: Qualifier presence per state and layout stability across state transitions [REQ:CC-P1-002].
Each ink renders distinguishably on a real page [REQ:CC-P1-002].

requirements.title: A room never renders blank
requirements.description: Every scene surface performs a first-frame render check and falls back to a composed still frame when nothing was drawn. A mounted canvas that produces no pixels is a failure, not a pass. This closes the defect where five of six scenes mounted correctly and drew nothing.

validation.notes: Pixel-nonblank assertion per room, replacing the exists-assertion that passed on empty canvases [REQ:CC-P1-003].

requirements.title: Each room has a portrait composition
requirements.description: Every room ships a designed narrow-viewport composition — figure, reduced scene band, stacked supporting readings — rather than a scaled or letterboxed landscape layout. Room identity survives at 390px; no page scrolls horizontally at any width.

validation.notes: Portrait viewport renders the designed composition and never overflows [REQ:CC-P1-004].

requirements.title: A figure keeps its contrast floor over a live scene
requirements.description: Each room declares quiet zones the scene may not render into, and a scrim under every figure region. The measured worst-case contrast ratio across sampled frames of a running scene meets WCAG 2.1 AA, not merely the average or a single still.

validation.notes: Sampled-frame contrast measurement against the live scene [REQ:CC-P1-005].

requirements.title: Type composites above postprocessing
requirements.description: The figure layer is composited above any scene postprocessing pass. Bloom and similar effects apply to the scene only, never to hairline provenance strokes, whose smearing would destroy the honesty system.

validation.notes: Layer order holds with postprocessing enabled [REQ:CC-P1-006].

requirements.title: Idle state carries no chrome
requirements.description: With no input the board shows the room and nothing else — no navigation, no settings, no buttons. The control bar reveals on any input at 64px targets and fades after four seconds of quiet. The cycle rail is the only persistent chrome.

validation.notes: Idle render exposes no interactive chrome; input reveals it [REQ:CC-P1-007].

requirements.title: Cycle pauses on interaction and resumes on idle
requirements.description: Interaction pauses the auto-cycle and twenty seconds of inactivity resumes it. The cycle rail visibly stops and restarts so a paused board never reads as a frozen one. Cycle duration, starting room and reveal state are settable by URL parameter.

requirements.title: Four input classes, one intent vocabulary
requirements.description: Gamepad, keyboard, touch and pointer resolve to a single intent set before anything reacts, built on the shared GamepadAction vocabulary from the spatial navigation package rather than a scenario-local one. Identical intents produce identical behaviour regardless of origin device.

validation.notes: Every input class maps onto the shared vocabulary and produces one behaviour [REQ:CC-P1-009].

requirements.title: Every command acknowledges
requirements.description: Fullscreen, wake-lock, room change and cycle toggle each show pending, success, failure or unavailable. Fullscreen and wake-lock fail silently on some TV browsers; that surfaces as a stated line in the control bar, never as a console warning and never as a blocking dialog.

validation.notes: Unavailable capability produces a visible stated result [REQ:CC-P1-010].

requirements.title: Audience modes gate illustrative readings
requirements.description: samples=hide withholds every sample reading and composes the room from real readings only; samples=mark renders them in sample material with a persistent on-screen legend; samples=full renders them without the legend for internal use. The mode is visible in the board's own state so a screenshot is self-describing.

validation.notes: Each mode's filtering and legend behaviour [REQ:CC-P1-011].
hide mode shows no sample material anywhere on the page [REQ:CC-P1-011].

requirements.title: Capability ladder selects the scene tier
requirements.description: A runtime probe selects a scene tier and the board renders correctly at every tier — full scene with postprocessing, reduced scene without it, and a composed still. Tier selection never blocks first paint, and the figure layer is identical across tiers so the reading is never degraded to protect the decoration.

validation.notes: Tier selection, first-paint independence, and figure-layer parity [REQ:CC-P1-012].

requirements.title: Reduced motion is a designed state
requirements.description: Under prefers-reduced-motion, ambient scenes hold a composed still frame rather than blanking, the freshness indicator steps rather than sweeps, digits swap rather than roll, and room changes crossfade rather than fading through black.

validation.notes: Reduced-motion render is composed and non-blank [REQ:CC-P1-013].

requirements.title: Themes are library token overrides
requirements.description: Each room's theme is expressed as React Component Library semantic token overrides so library components inherit the active palette. The scenario-private --cc-* vocabulary is retired and no component reads it.

validation.notes: Every theme defines the library token set and no --cc-* variable remains [REQ:CC-P1-014].
